articles.headline: Ashour gets Egypt's campaign up and running
articles.description: Emam Ashour scores his first international goal in 30 appearances for Egypt as they hold Belgium to a 1-1 draw.

articles.headline: FIFA finds 'no evidence' of racist gesture by VAR assistant
articles.description: FIFA said Monday it found no evidence that VAR official Shaun Evans intentionally made a racist hand gesture ahead of Sunday's game between Germany and Curacao.

articles.headline: Romelu Lukaku inspires equaliser from the bench as Belgium, Egypt share points
articles.description: Romelu Lukaku's mere presence sparked an attack that led to Belgium's lone goal only seconds after he entered as a second-half substitute, helping his team earn a 1-1 draw with Egypt on Monday at the World Cup.
